title: Outboxes and database-backed jobs
brief: Commit a durable intention, then deliver and claim work despite duplicate execution and worker loss.
outcomes: Explain what an outbox makes atomic
Design deduplication, leases and fencing for recoverable workers
entry: Transactions, uncertain outcomes and lock/claim reasoning from RL91 before recoverable worker protocols.

heading.title: An order and its message
heading.brief: Commit order 103 and an outbox event together; follow crash points before and after send without promising exactly-once delivery.

heading.title: Repeated delivery
heading.brief: Carry event identity to a consumer’s deduplication boundary; state whether that boundary can be committed atomically with the effect.

heading.title: Claiming database work
heading.brief: Use bounded job claims, attempts and acknowledgement; compare lock-held processing with leases and show recovery from a failed worker.

heading.title: Expired authority
heading.brief: Pause a worker past its lease and resume it after reassignment; require the effect authority to reject an older fencing token.
